tools.name: search-content
tools.description: Search screen text, audio transcriptions, input events, and memories. Returns timestamped results with app context. IMPORTANT: prefer activity-summary for broad questions ('what was I doing?'). Use search-content only when you need specific text/content. Start with limit=5, increase only if needed. Results can be large — use max_content_length=500 to truncate.

q.description: Full-text search query. Omit to return all content in time range. Avoid for audio — transcriptions are noisy, q filters too aggressively.

content_type.description: Filter by content type. 'accessibility' is preferred for screen text (OS-native). 'ocr' is fallback for apps without accessibility support. Default: 'all'.

limit.description: Max results (default 10, max 20). Start with 5 for exploration.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Use when results say 'use offset=N for more'.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC or relative (e.g. '2h ago', '1d ago'). Always provide to avoid scanning entire history.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC or relative (e.g. 'now'). Defaults to now.

app_name.description: Filter by app name (e.g. 'Google Chrome', 'Slack', 'zoom.us'). Case-sensitive.

include_frames.description: Include base64 screenshots (OCR only). Warning: large response.

speaker_ids.description: Comma-separated speaker IDs to filter audio

speaker_name.description: Filter audio by speaker name (case-insensitive partial match)

max_content_length.description: Truncate each result's text via middle-truncation. Use 200-500 to keep responses compact.

tools.name: list-meetings
tools.description: List detected meetings (Zoom, Teams, Meet, etc.) with duration, app, and attendees. Only available when screenpipe runs in smart transcription mode.

tools.name: activity-summary
tools.description: Rich activity overview: app usage, window/tab titles with URLs and time spent, key text per context, audio transcriptions. USE THIS FIRST for broad questions: 'what was I doing?', 'how long on X?', 'which apps?'. The 'windows' field shows exactly what the user worked on (e.g. 'Debug crash issue — 20 min', 'Stripe pricing page — 5 min'). Usually sufficient without further searches.

app_name.description: Optional app name filter to focus on one app

tools.name: search-elements
tools.description: Search UI elements (buttons, links, text fields) from the accessibility tree. Lighter than search-content for targeted UI lookups. Use when you need to find specific UI controls or page structure, not general content.

frame_id.description: Filter to specific frame ID from search results

source.description: Element source. 'accessibility' is preferred (OS-native tree). 'ocr' for apps without a11y.

tools.name: frame-context
tools.description: Get full accessibility text, parsed tree nodes, and URLs for a specific frame ID. Use after search-content to get detailed context for a specific moment.

frame_id.description: Frame ID from search-content results (content.frame_id field)

tools.name: export-video
tools.description: Export an MP4 video of screen recordings for a time range. Returns the file path. Can take a few minutes for long ranges.

fps.description: Output FPS (default 1.0). Higher = smoother but larger file.

tools.name: update-memory
tools.description: Create, update, or delete a persistent memory (facts, preferences, decisions the user wants to remember). To retrieve memories, use search-content with content_type='memory'. To create: provide content + tags. To update: provide id + fields to change. To delete: provide id + delete=true.

id.description: Memory ID — omit to create new, provide to update/delete

source_context.description: Optional metadata linking to source (app, timestamp, etc.)

delete.description: Set true to delete the memory identified by id

tools.name: send-notification
tools.description: Send a notification to the screenpipe desktop UI. Use to alert the user about findings, completed tasks, or actions needing attention.

pipe_name.description: Name of the pipe/tool sending this notification

timeout_secs.description: Auto-dismiss after N seconds (default 20). Use 0 for persistent.

actions.description: Up to 5 action buttons. Each needs id, label, type ('pipe'|'api'|'deeplink'|'dismiss').

open_in_chat.description: Open pipe run in chat UI instead of background (type=pipe)

tools.name: health-check
tools.description: Check if screenpipe is running and healthy. Returns recording status, frame/audio stats, timestamps.

tools.name: list-audio-devices
tools.description: List available audio input/output devices for recording.

tools.name: list-monitors
tools.description: List available monitors/screens for capture.

tools.name: add-tags
tools.description: Add tags to a content item (vision frame or audio chunk) for organization and retrieval.

tools.name: search-speakers
tools.description: Search for speakers by name prefix. Returns speaker ID, name, and metadata.

name.description: Speaker name prefix to search for (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list-unnamed-speakers
tools.description: List speakers that haven't been named yet. Useful for speaker identification workflow.

tools.name: update-speaker
tools.description: Rename a speaker or update their metadata.

tools.name: merge-speakers
tools.description: Merge two speakers into one (e.g. when the same person was detected as different speakers).

speaker_to_merge_id.description: Speaker ID to merge into the kept one

tools.name: start-meeting
tools.description: Manually start a meeting recording session.

tools.name: stop-meeting
tools.description: Stop the current manual meeting recording session.

tools.name: get-meeting
tools.description: Get details of a specific meeting by ID, including transcription and attendees.

tools.name: update-meeting
tools.description: Update a meeting's mutable fields (title, attendees, note, app, start/end). Partial: only the fields you pass are written, others stay as-is. Use this to save an AI-generated summary into the meeting note — read the current note first via get-meeting and pass the existing notes plus your additions so you don't overwrite the user's writing. Convention: append AI-generated summary text under a `## Summary` heading at the bottom of the existing note.

note.description: Full new note body. To preserve existing notes, fetch them first via get-meeting and concatenate before passing.

tools.name: keyword-search
tools.description: Fast keyword search using FTS index. Faster than search-content for exact keyword matching. Returns frame IDs and matched text.

tools.name: get-frame-elements
tools.description: Get all UI elements for a specific frame. More targeted than search-elements when you already have a frame_id.

tools.name: control-recording
tools.description: Start or stop audio/screen recording. Use to pause/resume capture.
